title: Causal mask
goal:
In the decoder, position $i$ can attend only to positions $j \le i$ (Section 3.1 and Section 3.2.3). Write `causal_mask(n)`, which returns an `(n, n)` boolean array. Entry `[i, j]` is `True` when query `i` may attend to key `j`.

The starter includes a finished `scaled_dot_product_attention` that takes the mask. Your mask must give the weights in the tiny example from the page: row 0 attends only to itself.
hints: `np.tril` keeps the lower triangle, including the diagonal. `np.triu` keeps the upper triangle.
Start from `np.ones((n, n), dtype=bool)`. The diagonal must be `True`, or the first query has nothing to attend to.
Use `True` for "may attend". The helper in the starter replaces the `False` entries with `-1e9`.
